pages.text: Just as copper has a wondrous capacity to conduct lightning, I have found that seashell brass has a similar capacity to conduct explosions - a very different natural force, despite their superficial similarities. With this property, I have devised an explosion rod, which works like a lightning rod but, rather than lightning, draws in explosions in a radius of 128 blocks.

This will be useful as a safeguard in case my experiments with TNT go awry, as well as to defend my delicate ritual pools from any stray creepers that might wander through them. I should place it somewhere blast-resistant, however - while the rod itself is highly resistant to the explosions it draws in, its surroundings have no such protection.
